name: Doric 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Heavy display letters with bracketed slab serifs, rounded bowls and a substantial historical lowercase.
observed: Directly traced characters: 0123456789ABCDEFGHILMNOQRSTUVYacdehiklmnoqrstuv. Printed page 138, PDF page 144. Larger impressions anchor the master; smaller optical sizes supply additional characters. Crops are retained for separately labelled small-source reconstructions as well. Additional directly traced impressions supply JKbfgj. Exact editions, pages, crops, scale anchors and cleanup are recorded in source/tracing.json and reference/specimen-restoration-sources.json.
reconstructed: Inferred companion letters and figures: XZpwxyz. Punctuation and remaining symbols are new project drawings. Both historical cases are retained. Spacing and harmonisation of optical sizes are modern choices. The 1889 suffix dates the source, not a claim of first release. Characters redrawn in place of coarse smaller-size traces: PW; see companions.json for the construction of each.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Doric; printed p. 138, one-based PDF page 144, Internet Archive leaf 144
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.
